text: DSH Sidecar Browser 是一个面向 DSH 网页客户端的 AI 侧边浏览器插件。它在右侧栏注册原生 Electron webview 标签页，并通过本机桥接服务让模型控制各会话独立的浏览器页面。用户可以让模型导航网页、读取和比较页面结构、提取字段或表格、点击和填写表单，也能批量执行带结果断言的操作，并随时接管浏览器。它还提供截图、标签管理和重复流程配方。适合需要 agent 在真实网页中查找信息或完成交互任务的 DSH 用户；运行需要 DSH 桌面侧原生浏览器桥接支持，代码未声明外部 API 密钥。

DSH Sidecar Browser adds an agent-operated Electron browser to DSH's right sidebar. Its tools navigate, inspect or extract page content, click and fill forms, and run action batches. Users can take over; tabs are session-scoped. It requires DSH's local browser bridge and declares no API key.

能不能让模型在网页上点击按钮并填写表单？
我需要从当前网页中提取指定字段或表格。
让 DSH 能检查页面更新，只返回变化的内容。
我想把网页上的几个操作连起来执行并确认结果。
I want my DSH agent to browse and interact with real web pages.
DSH Sidecar Browser 的功能「模型驱动网页操作」：在 DSH 右侧栏的原生浏览器中打开网页，并通过工具导航、观察页面、点击、输入或执行组合操作。工具调用可指定标签页，页面也可由用户接管。
DSH Sidecar Browser 的功能「网页结构提取与变化检查」：模型可通过 observe 获取页面结构或增量变化，也可用 extract 按查询、字段、表格等方式抽取当前页内容，结果可保存到跨标签页工作区。

**A real browser, on the side of your agent.**

> The model can read the web. Now it can actually use it.

dsh-sidecar-browser README · DSH Sidecar Browser：DSH Sidecar Browser puts a real Electron browser in the **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**
right sidebar. It is not a screenshot robot and not another DOM scraper. The
agent gets a browser it can navigate, inspect, click, type into, upload files to
and assert against — while you keep it visible, take over when you want, and
hand control back when you are done.

No Playwright. No separate browser process. No cloud relay. Just a native
sidebar webview, a narrow local bridge and a very opinionated toolset.
dsh-sidecar-browser README · DSH Sidecar Browser：[English](#english) | [简体中文](#简体中文) ---

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Why another browser tool?：Most agent browsers are either:

- **screenshot-first**: expensive, slow, and hard to assert against
- **scraper-first**: great at reading HTML, useless when a real click is needed
- **remote-first**: your browsing session leaves your machine

DSH Sidecar Browser is built the other way around: **actions first, observations
on a diet, everything visible and local**.

dsh-sidecar-browser README · What makes it different：- **A real browser, not a simulation.** Native Electron `<webview>` with real
  navigation, downloads, file inputs, dialogs and tabs.
- **Token-efficient by design.** Snapshot modes `minimal`, `interactive`,
  `standard` and `full`, revision deltas, and a 12-character `UNCHANGED`
  response when a page did not move.
- **Built for actions, not just reads.** Batched `act` steps, per-step `expect`
  assertions, structured `extract`, and failure diagnostics that tell you *why*
  an element was not clickable.
- **Obstacles surfaced early.** `pointer-events:none` inputs are reported at
  observe time with the label to click instead; non-HTML documents return text
  from `extract` instead of throwing.
- **Human in the loop.** Take over the browser at any time; the agent waits.
- **Session-scoped tabs.** Every conversation gets its own browser tab; tools
  never fall back to another conversation's active page.
- **Scope-independent IDs.** The same element keeps the same `dsh-*` id whether
  you observe the full page or a subtree, so changing scope cannot silently
  retarget a click.
- **Local-first.** The bridge binds to `127.0.0.1:32002

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Install in 10 seconds：Open DSH:

```text
Plugins → Add plugin
```

Paste:

```text
https://github.com/ccharlesjin/dsh-sidecar-browser
```

Or use the published npm package:

```text
dsh-sidecar-browser
```

After install, enable the `dsh-sidecar-browser` bundle and restart DSH if the
right-sidebar browser does not appear.

From a local checkout:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Install in 10 seconds：> Already using the old `@local/dsh-browser-live` plugin? Do **not** install both
> side by side. Run `migrate-from-local.ps1` first; it backs up your config and
> removes the old profile registration.

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Feature tour：| Area | What you get |
|---|---|
| Navigation | tabs, history, back/reload, target="_blank" in current tab, user takeover |
| Observation | budgets, interactive-only mode with context, deltas, scoped reads, revisions |
| Actions | click, type, select, hover, batched act, assertions, retries |
| Extraction | semantic query, CSS fields, tables, meta, JSON-LD, debug hints |
| Diagnostics | not-found candidates, actionability reasons, console context |
| Files | file input upload, drag/drop, controlled downloads |
| Visual | viewport, element and stitched full-page screenshots |
| State | cross-tab workspace, recipes, declarative tasks |
| Safety | policy view, highlight, allowlists, upload roots |

dsh-sidecar-browser README · The toolbox：```text
native_browser_tabs        list or create tabs
native_browser_navigate    open a URL
native_browser_observe     full snapshot or revision delta
native_browser_extract     fields / table / meta / JSON-LD

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Token economics：Every tool is designed to keep context small:

- `snapshot: "none"` on action batches
- `observe` returns only what changed
- `extract` returns fields, not the whole page
- diagnostics are generated only on failure
- console output is attached only when relevant

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Optional core patch：A small DSH Electron main/preload patch unlocks the full desktop experience:

- native focus/input for background clicks
- read-only network capture
- controlled downloads
- screenshots

Without it, navigation, DOM reads, extraction, actions, assertions, upload/drop,
console and workspaces still work. Tools that need the core return a clear error.

The core patch is **version-specific**. Never install an `app.asar.patched` from a
different DSH release; rebuild it after each DSH update.

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Optional core patch：The patch lives in [`core-patch/`](./core-patch/README.md) in this repository,
excluded from the npm package. It contains source diffs and explicit
build/install/restore scripts — no prebuilt `app.asar` and no `postinstall`:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/ccharlesjin/dsh-sidecar-browser.git
cd dsh-sidecar-browser\core-patch
npm install
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\update.ps1

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Optional core patch：`update.ps1` pulls the latest repository, detects the installed DSH version,
builds the matching version folder, and installs it with a backup.

Read [core-patch/README.md](./core-patch/README.md) first: it modifies the DSH
main process and makes a timestamped backup before installing.

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Safety defaults：- Uploads and drag/drop are restricted by `policy.json → uploadRoots`
- Empty `uploadRoots` rejects all local uploads until configured
- Network summaries store no headers or bodies; explicit request detail returns
  redacted request/response headers only, never response bodies
- URLs and console text redact token/JWT/Bearer-style parameters
- Downloads go to `Downloads/DSH Browser`, sanitized, never auto-opened

dsh-sidecar-browser README · User data：Runtime data lives outside the package:

```text
~/.dsh/ai-browser/policy.json
~/.dsh/ai-browser/recipes.json
~/.dsh/ai-browser/host.log
~/.dsh/ai-browser/screenshots/

Package updates will not overwrite your allowlists, recipes or screenshots.

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Development：```powershell
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run
```

There is no build step. `index.js`, `client.js` and `native-bridge.cjs` are the
shipped runtime. The `dsh` field in `package.json` wires the bundle and the
right-sidebar client.

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 简体中文：**一个真正长在 Agent 身边的浏览器。**

> 模型能读网页，现在也能真正“用”网页。

DSH Sidecar Browser 把真实的 Electron 浏览器放进 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**
右侧栏。它不是截图机器人，也不是只会抓 DOM 的爬虫。模型可以导航、读取、点击、输入、
上传文件、做断言，而你可以随时看到它在干什么、亲手接管，再交还控制权。

没有 Playwright，没有独立浏览器进程，没有云端中转。只有原生侧栏 webview、一条很窄的
本机 bridge，和一套很有主见的工具。

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 为什么再造一个浏览器工具：大多数 Agent 浏览器是这三种之一：

- **截图优先**：贵、慢，还很难断言
- **爬虫优先**：读 HTML 很强，一到真实点击就废
- **远程优先**：浏览会话离开你的电脑

DSH Sidecar Browser 反过来做：**动作优先、观察节食、全程可见、数据留在本地**。
section: 为什么再造一个浏览器工具

text:
dsh-sidecar-browser README · 不一样在哪：- **真浏览器，不是模拟。** 原生 Electron `<webview>`，真实导航、下载、文件选择、
  对话框和多标签。
- **天生省 token。** 快照模式 `minimal` / `interactive` / `standard` / `full`，支持
  revision 增量；页面没变化时只回 12 个字符的 `UNCHANGED`。
- **为动作而生，不只是读页面。** 批量 `act`、逐步 `expect` 断言、结构化 `extract`，
  失败时直接告诉你元素为什么点不了。
- **障碍提前暴露。** `pointer-events:none` 的输入框在观察阶段就会提示应该点哪个
  label；非 HTML 文档的 `extract` 会回退返回文本，而不是直接报错。
- **人可以随时接管。** 你接管浏览器，Agent 等待；你交还，它继续。
- **标签按会话隔离。** 每个对话使用自己的 AI 浏览器标签，工具不会回退到其他对话的
  页面。
- **ID 不随 scope 漂移。** 同一个元素，无论全量观察还是 scope 子树，都保持同一个
  `dsh-*` id；切换观察范围不会让点击悄悄落到邻居元素上。
- **本地优先。** bridge 只监听 `127.0.0.1:32002`，页面数据不经过云端。
- **自带安全边界。** 上传目录白名单、token 脱敏、受控下载目录、不自动打开文件。

```

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 能力一览：| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 导航 | 标签页、历史、后退/刷新、target="_blank" 当前标签打开、用户接管 |
| 观察 | 多档快照、interactive 模式（仅动作元素 + 上下文）、增量 diff、范围读取 |
| 动作 | 点击、输入、选择、悬停、批量 act、断言、重试 |
| 提取 | 语义 query、CSS 字段、表格、meta、JSON-LD、debug |
| 诊断 | 找不到元素时候选列表、不可点击原因、console 上下文 |
| 文件 | file input 上传、拖拽上传、受控下载 |
| 视觉 | viewport、元素、拼接 full-page 截图 |
| 状态 | 跨标签 workspace、recipe、声明式 task |
| 安全 | policy 查看、高亮审计、域名白名单、上传目录限制 |

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 工具箱：```text
native_browser_tabs        列出或创建标签页
native_browser_navigate    打开 URL
native_browser_observe     完整快照或 revision 增量
native_browser_extract     字段 / 表格 / meta / JSON-LD

dsh-sidecar-browser README · Token 省在哪：每个工具都在控制上下文体积：

- 动作批次默认 `snapshot: "none"`
- `observe` 只返回变化部分
- `extract` 只返回字段，不返回整页
- 只有失败时才生成诊断
- console 只在相关时附加

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 可选 core patch：一小块 DSH Electron main/preload 补丁可以解锁完整桌面能力：

- 后台点击的原生 focus/input
- 只读 network 捕获
- 受控下载
- 截图

没有补丁时，导航、DOM 读取、提取、动作、断言、上传/拖拽、console、workspace
仍然可用；需要 core 的工具会返回明确错误。

core patch 和 DSH 版本绑定，**不要**把其他版本的 `app.asar.patched` 直接装到当前
版本；每次 DSH 更新后都要重新构建。

补丁源码、构建脚本和安装/恢复脚本在本仓库的 [`core-patch/`](./core-patch/README.md)
子目录，已排除出 npm 包；不包含预构建 `app.asar`，也不会通过 `postinstall`
自动修改主程序：

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 可选 core patch：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/ccharlesjin/dsh-sidecar-browser.git
cd dsh-sidecar-browser\core-patch
npm install
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\update.ps1

`update.ps1` 会拉取最新仓库、检测已安装 DSH 版本、构建匹配版本并带备份安装。

安装前先读 [core-patch/README.md](./core-patch/README.md)：它会修改 DSH 主进程，但会先创建带时间戳的备份。

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 安全默认值：- 上传和拖拽受 `policy.json → uploadRoots` 限制
- `uploadRoots` 为空时默认拒绝所有本地上传
- network 摘要不保存 headers/body；显式单请求详情只返回脱敏后的请求/响应 headers，
  不返回响应 body
- URL 和 console 文本会脱敏 token / JWT / Bearer 参数
- 下载只写到 `Downloads/DSH Browser`，清理文件名，不覆盖，不自动打开

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 用户数据：运行数据在包目录之外：

```text
~/.dsh/ai-browser/policy.json
~/.dsh/ai-browser/recipes.json
~/.dsh/ai-browser/host.log
~/.dsh/ai-browser/screenshots/

升级插件不会覆盖你的 allowlist、recipes 或截图。

dsh-sidecar-browser README · 开发：```powershell
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run
```

没有构建步骤，`index.js`、`client.js`、`native-bridge.cjs` 就是运行时。
`package.json` 的 `dsh` 字段负责 bundle 和右侧栏客户端注入。
